name: Goblin Shaman
author: Hendrik Berends
description: A Gobbapalooza is a gaggle of wise-grots who advise their boss whether he asked or not, and one of them can usually be talked into following a warband into the ruins for a share of the shinies. Which one turns up says everything about how the next fight will go.

choose.prompt: When you recruit this fighter, select one of the following roles. It gains that role's talent and is armed with the weapon shown alongside it.

abilities.name: Fungus Brew
abilities.text: In the first and second battle rounds, subtract 1 from the damage allocated to this fighter for each hit and critical hit, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Slippery Git
abilities.text: This fighter is in cover while it is within 1" of another friendly `GOBLIN` fighter.

abilities.name: Gaze of Mork
abilities.text: Magical ability. Select the closest visible enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter and roll three dice. For each roll of 4+, allocate (X/2) damage points to that fighter.

abilities.name: Hypnotic Gaze
abilities.text: Magical ability. Select a visible fighter within (X)" of this fighter. If it is an enemy fighter, it becomes Panicked. If it is a friendly fighter, it automatically passes Bravery tests until the end of the battle round.

abilities.name: Gargant Brew
abilities.text: Magical ability. Select a friendly `ORC` or `GOBLIN` fighter within (X)" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, add 1 to its Fight characteristic. At the start of the next battle round, that fighter becomes Panicked.

abilities.name: Waves of Terror
abilities.text: Magical ability. Each enemy fighter within (X)" of this fighter must take a Bravery test or become Panicked.

abilities.name: Bloatstool Spores
abilities.text: Magical ability. Roll a die for each enemy fighter within (X/2)" of this fighter. On a 3+, allocate (X/2) damage points to that fighter.

abilities.name: Extra-Nasty
abilities.text: Magical ability. Select a friendly `GOBLIN` fighter within (X)" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, add 2 to the damage allocated for each critical hit scored by that fighter's melee attack actions.
